hero.title: Stop chasing clients. Let them come to you.
hero.lead: You're good at what you do. Getting people to book you shouldn't take everything you've got. We build the system that does it for you.
pains: They ask what I charge… and then just vanish.
Loads of likes. Nobody actually books.
I always mean to follow up. Then the week's just gone.
I never know where the next one's coming from.

system.title: One path. From “never heard of you” to “booked.”
system.lead: Built, connected and launched for you. You never touch the tech.

steps.title: They see you
steps.text: The right people notice you. Not everyone, the ones already looking.

steps.title: They reach out
steps.text: Instead of a like that disappears, they leave their details.

steps.title: It follows up
steps.text: Warm replies and reminders go out on their own, even while you're mid-session.

steps.title: They book you
steps.text: A couple of taps and they're on your calendar. No chasing from you.

system.chatIn: Hi! What does working together look like?
system.chatOut: Good question. Here's a time that works for both of us.
system.bookedNote: On your calendar, not in your DMs.
system.loopNote: Why a loop? Because it doesn’t stop at the booking. The same follow-up stays in touch afterwards, so good clients come back instead of drifting off.

doors.title: Pick how much you want off your plate.
doors.lead: Same building blocks, three ways to get them.

sistema.title: The System
sistema.kicker: We build and run the whole thing
sistema.text: Landing page, booking, Meta Ads, follow-up and WhatsApp, connected into one path and handed over working. One fixed scope, one fixed price, live in days.

servicios.title: Done for you, piece by piece
servicios.kicker: We do one part for you
servicios.text: Need just the landing page, the ads or the booking setup? Each module has a fixed scope and a fixed price, and fits into the System later.

productos.title: Products
productos.text: Templates and kits for people who'd rather build it themselves, made from what we use with clients.

proof.title: What it looks like for a real business.
proof.pendingNote: Figures marked [PENDIENTE] are waiting for the client's sign-off.

statement.text: Being noticed is the easy part. What happens in the next ten minutes is where a client is won or lost.
statement.note: That gap between “interested” and “booked” is the only thing we build.

fit.title: For coaches, entrepreneurs and business owners.
fit.lead: More exactly: any business where clients book you directly. We'd rather say no now than take your money for something that won't work.
for: You coach, consult, treat or run a business where clients book you directly.
People have already paid for what you do. You just want more of them.
You're tired of your income depending on posting and luck.
You'd rather have it built for you than learn another tool.
not: You don't have an offer people have paid for yet. A system can't fix that, and we'll say so.
You want someone to run your social media or make content. That's not what we build.

process.title: How working with us goes.
process.lead: Four steps. You can stop after any of them.

steps.title: The free call
steps.text: Thirty minutes looking at your actual business. You leave knowing where clients slip away, with us or without us.

steps.title: A fixed scope and a fixed price
steps.text: If you want it built, we write down exactly what you get and what it costs. No hourly surprises.

steps.title: You tell us how you work
steps.text: Your offer, your calendar, how you like to talk to clients. About an hour of your time.

steps.title: We build, connect and launch
steps.text: You never touch the tech, and you always know what's happening, in plain words. Then we stay on to improve it, if you want.

founders.title: We're a small agency, and that's on purpose.
body: Hi, we're Miguel and Christiane. Ten years in marketing taught us one thing: single pieces rarely change a business. A nice landing page here, one clever campaign there. It helps, then it fades, because everything around it is still held together by hand.
So we build the whole thing, connected, and hand it over working. And we use it ourselves.

values.title: Plain words
values.text: If we can't say it simply, we don't say it.

values.title: Honest fit
values.text: If it's not right for you, we'll tell you.

final.title: Find out where clients are slipping away.
final.text: One call. We look at how people find you now, where they drop out, and what it would take to keep them. More on your calendar, fewer hours in your DMs.
